title: Daily Digest B: Records + Honors (Mon Nov 16)
parts:
🏆 DEVYDOSE DAILY BUZZ | Week 11 honors

Two records for the No. 1 player on the board, a freshman honor in Miami, and a sophomore back rewriting Duke's books 🧵👇

📈 JEREMIAH SMITH | WR | Ohio State | JR, 5⭐ | #1 WR

He became the Big Ten's all-time career receiving yards leader vs Northwestern (via 247Sports, On3).

His 3,875 yards are also an FBS record for a player's first 3 college seasons (h/t @dpbrugler).

🙌 JAVIAN MALLORY | RB | Miami | FR, 4⭐ | #21 RB (preseason: #59)

Named the 247Sports True Freshman of the Week after three second-half touchdowns in the win over Duke (via 247Sports).

🔥 NATE SHEPPARD | RB | Duke | SO, 4⭐ | #1 RB (preseason: #32)

He's setting Duke records and getting stronger with every game (via On3).

Which of the three ends the year highest on the board? 👇
